message: I smoke Winston Light 100's and refuse to smoke any other brand. I bought a carton of W.L. 100's last week and noticed some of the bands at the base of the cigarettes were not sealed so I could not get a good draw from them. Not all of them were like that but many in each pack. I have enclosed 2 of them for you to examine. If you light them you will see smoke escaping from the base.
